description: Quick analyst notes for live result race pages.
instructions: Each race id goes under races.
Put the newest note first; only the first note displays fully.
If you add another note after an existing note, put a comma after the previous note's closing brace.
Allowed fields: date, author, role, text, image, embed.
Use either image or embed, not both, for simplicity.
Authors named Nathan Wang or gamerdoglover automatically get their saved profile image.

79777.author: Federal Elections Analysis
79777.text: California's open primary is a broad field test: early vote patterns and regional turnout will matter more than a traditional two-candidate partisan split.
